data.long_meaning: The name Sovon is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sarvan', which means 'all' or 'universal'. The name Sovon signifies the one who possesses all the wisdom and intelligence. This name is also associated with the Hindu god Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, and wisdom. The name Sovon carries the meaning “Wisdom, Intelligence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Sovon usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom, intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
